text:
Maya: quick async heads-up on quant + batching/caching handoff. TL;DR: quant-profile-v2 is green on offline eval, we have a suggested serving config and need owners for canary + alerts.
Jun: can you paste the perf deltas? also pinging for a docs/model-catalog update. PR?
Maya: perf summary: memory ~38% reduction, token-cost ~30% down; p90 latency +3% on long tails, median unchanged. eval quality delta: -0.5% average on our release eval set (subtle shift in entropies). overall OK but watch regressions.
Maya: example serving snippet we've been testing:
```yaml
model:
  quant_profile: v2
  quant_bits: 4
serving:
  batching:
    max_delay_ms: 8
    max_batch_size: 64
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_ms: 60000
```
Jun: nice. where is the regression harness? is this on the same prompt set we used last quarter? link?
Maya: harness is at internal/evals/optkit/seq-release-v3, same prompted suite + a new low-temp user-sim set. results + diffs are in the CI artifact: https://ci.redwood/local/4439/artifacts (summary table attached in CI).
Jun: ok. ownership question: who will run the canary and validate logs / hallucination checks?
Lee: I can own the canary on the dedicated pool. plan: 1) shadow traffic for 24h on 5% traffic, 2) run eval hooks every 2h, 3) automatic fallback to quant-v1 if KL-divergence > 0.02 or hallucination-rate delta > 0.3%.
Sam: for alerts, I'll wire a regression alert to the quality-monitoring dashboard and add a token-level cost alert to infra-SLOs. what's the threshold for rollback?
Lee: fallback triggers: KL > 0.02 OR mean-answer-divergence > 0.5 on our metrics. We also want manual abort option for oncall.
Maya: assign: Lee = canary owner, Sam = alerts/monitoring, Jun = docs + model-catalog entry + PR merge. Can we get PRs today?
Jun: I'll draft the model-catalog PR (will reference quant-profile-v2) and push a docs PR. putting a review request on PR 4455.
Maya: also small config tweak request: reduce batching window from 10ms to 8ms in this profile to keep tail latency tighter. Jun, Lee please sanity-check CPU/GPU utilization at 8ms.
Lee: will run microbenchmarks tomorrow morning and report. quick local run command: `bazel run //infra/bench:batch_warmup -- --max_delay_ms=8`
Sam: I'll add the alert rules to the staging dashboard and include a regression-playbook snippet.
Jun: quick CR ping to @maya on PR 4439 for the inference-runtime changes (small KV cache flag).
Maya: reviewing now, will leave comments in the PR by EOD.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z on pool:dedicated-opt-1 (5% shadow, 24h). :rocket:
Lee: noted. I'll start the smoke runs an hour before and validate end-to-end traces.
Sam: added three monitors: 
- quality-regression (CI-eval diff)
- hallucination-rate (sampled telemetry)
- token-cost-delta (>15% increase)
I'll link to the oncall runbook.
Maya: thanks all. action items summarized: Lee (canary + smoke), Sam (alerts + dashboards), Jun (docs + catalog PR 4455), Maya (validate eval diffs and follow up on CRs). We'll reconvene in the weekly infra/optimize sync, but call out here if blockers appear. :thumbsup:
Jun: will post PR links when ready.
Maya: closing thread — will update with the canary start log and any early regressions.
